title: Ad Ops Onboarding Manager - Publishers (Remote)
description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, seen by 300M+ people monthly. For 16 years, we’ve achieved double-digit growth by blending proprietary AI technology with manual optimization techniques to empower publishers. We are a culture-centric, location-independent organization that values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration.

MonetizeMore offers location and schedule freedom to every one of its team members. That means that you would have the lifestyle autonomy to choose to work from anywhere in the world, during the time of day you prefer. This new-age work lifestyle would enable you to engineer your ideal lifestyle. Say goodbye to endless commutes, stuffy business attire, and the arbitrary 9 to 5 work-day. Take your life back into your hands by joining the MonetizeMore team!

What You’ll Do

As part of our Publisher Centric Team , At M2, we focus and emphasize proactive Publisher Services. As the Onboarding Manager, your role is a critical "first impression" of our organization and our ability to support our publishing partners in reaching their goals.

You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. You are not just setting up accounts you are orchestrating a "White Glove" experience that reduces time-to-value and sets the stage for long-term retention. You also pay attention to improving our systems and processes along the way to continuously improve our service to publishers.

Responsibilities

  1. Project Management & Implementation
    • Lead the Lifecycle: Expertly manage the publisher journey from Sales endorsement to "Live" status. You are the project manager for the publisher’s first 30-90 days.
    • Technical Coordination: Collaborate with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to troubleshoot setup concerns (Header Bidding, GAM, wrappers) and ensure optimal configuration.
    • Feature Activation: Ensure all applicable M2 Tech Features are activated at launch to maximize publisher revenue immediately (KPI: Uptake %).
  2. Client-Centric Communication & Education
    • Kick-off & Strategy: Conduct kick-off calls to understand the publisher's specific business goals and align our implementation plan to meet them.
    • Ambassadorship: Act as the primary champion for M2 tools and products. Provide comprehensive walkthroughs to ensure publishers are comfortable and proficient with our platform.
    • Responsive Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for all questions during installation, providing guidance that is both technical and empathetic.
  3. Performance Analysis & Handoff
    • Performance Reviews: Conduct thorough 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews. Use data to demonstrate value and identify early optimization wins.
    • Seamless Transition: Manage a structured handoff to the Ad Optimizer and Customer Success Manager, ensuring no momentum is lost after the initial 30-day period.

Day-today Activities

You are the external face of MonetizeMore for our newest partners. You thrive on variety and high-energy interaction—no two days (or publishers) are exactly alike.

  • External Engagement: You will constantly meet new partners, leading high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their specific business goals.
  • Project Command: You project manage the entire implementation lifecycle, coordinating between the publisher and our technical teams to ensure an optimal, revenue-ready setup and accelerated scale.
  • Performance Ownership: You don't just "set it and forget it." You conduct data-driven 7-day and 30-day etc. performance reviews to prove value immediately.
  • Seamless Handoff: Once the foundation is solid, you orchestrate a smooth transfer to the account management team ensuring the relationship momentum continues uninterrupted.

How this role fits into the organization

This is a cornerstone role that is pivotal to our company’s success.

  • Strategic Impact: Reporting to the Ad Ops Team Manager, you are the architect of the "First 30 Days." Since our publishers' growth is our growth, our long-term revenue goals effectively start on your desk.
  • The "Wow" Factor: You are responsible for delivering the "White Glove" experience. You set the trajectory for retention by uncovering publisher goals early and proving that MonetizeMore is a partner, not just a vendor.
  • Bridge Builder: You act as the vital link between Sales promises and long-term Operational success, ensuring that every new client enters our ecosystem with clarity, confidence, and a setup primed for revenue generation.

Who You Are

Must Haves

  • Experience: 1+ years of experience in Programmatic sell-side advertising, Customer Onboarding, or Ad Operations.
  • Technical Knowledge: Understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM), AdSense, Header Bidding, and Google Analytics. Experience with WordPress and debugging ad calls is a strong plus.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data presentation tools. You can spot trends in numbers quickly.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You can command a room (virtually) and manage expectations clearly.
  • Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple implementations simultaneously without dropping the ball.

Nice to Have

  • Has worked with AdSense, Google Analytics, and GAM and has extensive knowledge of Google policies and other platforms
  • Understands coding and has a strong tech background
  • Has worked with WordPress and is knowledgeable when it comes to implementing ads and debugging ad calls
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and Spanish are an extra bonus

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary : Our salary formula adjusts to your cost of living and experience.
  • Work remotely : Live and work wherever you like!
  • Flexible working hours : You have the autonomy to set your own schedule
  • Retreats : We meet in person for company get-togethers.
  • Career growth and learning opportunities

If you think you are a good fit to join our Ad Optimization , please apply on this side bar and give specific reasons what sets you apart. We hire individuals, not robots so don’t be afraid to show a little personality.

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion. Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

The Collections Counselor supports students with aging or past-due balances by providing clear, accurate, and compassionate financial guidance. The role conducts proactive outreach, explains payment options, resolves discrepancies, documents activity thoroughly, and collaborates with campus partners to help students regain good financial standing. The position ensures all counseling and communications align with university policies, federal regulations, and service quality standards.

Supervisory Accountability

None

Nature And Scope

The Collections Counselor serves as a frontline financial support specialist within Student Accounts, working directly with students whose balances require follow-up or repayment. The Counselor communicates regularly via phone, email, ticketing, and in-person appointments— occasionally during nontraditional hours—to explain account status, payment plans, holds, and next steps. The role requires strong communication skills, customer-service orientation, attention to detail, and the ability to support adult and traditional learners navigating financial challenges. The incumbent works closely with Collections Leads, Student Accounts Advisors, Cashiering Services, Financial Aid, the Registrar’s Office, Treasury, and other campus partners to resolve discrepancies, verify adjustments, and support the timely and accurate processing of payments. The Counselor reinforces university expectations while maintaining a student-centered, empathetic approach.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct outreach to students with past-due balances to explain account status, payment requirements, repayment options, and consequences of nonpayment.
  • Provide empathetic, student-centered counseling on payment plans, outstanding charges, financial holds, and available resources.
  • Assist students with setting up, monitoring, and understanding payment plan terms, deadlines, and consequences for missed payments.
  • Conduct thorough account reviews, identify discrepancies, and escalate complex or unusual cases to the Collections Lead.

Job Summary

The Accounts Receivable Analyst is responsible for managing and processing incoming payments, ensuring accurate record-keeping, reconciling customer accounts, and supporting the company's cash flow management. This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with internal teams and external customers.

Billing & Payment Processing

  • Record and reconcile incoming payments, ensuring correct allocation to customer accounts.
  • Monitor outstanding balances and follow up on overdue payments.
  • Process credit notes, adjustments, and refunds as necessary.

Reconciliation & Reporting

  • Reconcile customer accounts, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
  • Prepare and analyze aging reports to track overdue accounts.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities with necessary reports and reconciliations.

Collections & Customer Communication

  • Contact customers regarding overdue payments and negotiate payment arrangements when necessary.
  • Maintain strong customer relationships by addressing payment-related inquiries and disputes.
  • Work closely with the sales and customer service teams to resolve billing discrepancies.

Compliance & Process Improvement

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls, and financial regulations.
  • Assist in audits by providing necessary documentation and responding to inquiries.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and automation to enhance efficiency.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in accounts receivable, finance, or accounting.
  • Strong knowledge of accounts receivable processes, invoicing, and financial regulations.
  • Proficiency in ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) and Microsoft Excel.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Effective communication and negotiation skills for customer interactions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the hospitality a plus.
  • Knowledge of credit risk assessment and collections strategies.
  • Familiarity with automated accounts receivable systems.

title: E-Commerce & Marketing Manager
description:
Sofitel

Emerging as a pioneering French luxury hospitality brand in 1964, Sofitel brings French zest and inspires heartfelt encounters to the most sought‑after destinations worldwide. Seamlessly melding local culture with the French zest for life through remarkable savoir‑faire and generous service, Sofitel is for free‑minded travelers and arts and culture aficionados who have an appreciation for a refined and understated sense of modern luxury.

Our Brand

With over 115 Sofitel and Sofitel Legend hotels in more than 45 countries, our reach is truly global, making the sky the limit for growth opportunities. As our portfolio expands each year, there are ample opportunities to be involved in both our existing properties and our future openings.

Our Hotel

As a landmark for Sofitel in the Americas, Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema re‑emerges as a revitalized beachfront icon where French elegance meets the vibrant Carioca lifestyle. Designed as a sanctuary of art, craftsmanship, and sensory experiences, the hotel sets a new benchmark for luxury hospitality in Rio de Janeiro.

The property features 172 rooms and suites with the signature Sofitel MyBed, refined art‑filled interiors, and sweeping views of Two Brothers Hill. Guests enjoy elevated dining on the 22nd‑floor Chef’s Table, a rooftop infinity pool, wellness spa, Beach Club, and the exclusive Club Millésime lounge for personalized service and private check‑in.

The design vision is led by Brazilian architect Patricia Anastassiadis, whose storytelling approach blends heritage, artistry, and contemporary sophistication, creating spaces that feel both meaningful and deeply connected to place. Set beneath the iconic Christ the Redeemer, Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema stands as the ultimate destination for discerning travelers—where luxury meets the true soul of Rio.

Position

As our E-Commerce & Marketing Manager , you are the hotel’s digital and brand positioning architect. This role elevates the hotel’s visibility across all digital touchpoints, drives direct revenue growth, and safeguards brand integrity in alignment with Sofitel standards. As a key member of the Commercial Leadership Team, this role reports to the General Manager and combines strategic vision with analytical rigor, ensuring the hotel is positioned as a preferred destination for discerning travelers, meetings, and social events.

What You Will Do

Digital Strategy & Direct Revenue Growth

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive e‑commerce strategy to maximize direct bookings and optimize digital conversion
  • Drive performance across brand.com, OTA channels, luxury consortia platforms, and paid media
  • Oversee website content, digital platforms optimization, booking engine performance, and SEO/SEM initiatives
  • Manage digital campaigns with a strong ROI focus, including paid search, display, retargeting, and metasearch
  • Monitor digital KPIs (conversion, traffic, pace, channel mix) and provide actionable insights

Brand & Positioning

  • Protect and elevate the hotel’s luxury positioning across all digital and print platforms
  • Ensure all content reflects the hotel’s identity, storytelling, and service ethos
  • Collaborate with global/brand teams to ensure compliance with brand standards and campaigns
  • Lead content creation including photography, video, social storytelling, and partnership activations

Social Media & Content Marketing

  • Curate a refined and aspirational social presence aligned with luxury traveler expectations
  • Develop an annual content calendar supporting key revenue periods, F&B activations, spa offerings, and seasonal experiences
  • Foster influencer, media, and strategic partnerships that enhance brand visibility

Performance Marketing & Analytics

  • Own monthly digital performance reporting and budget tracking
  • Analyze market trends, competitive positioning, and customer behavior
  • Identify new digital opportunities to enhance share of voice and market share
  • Work closely with Revenue Management to align digital strategy with pricing and demand periods

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales, Revenue, and Operations to support need periods, group campaigns, and F&B initiatives
  • Support hotel’s pre‑opening positioning strategies
  • Act as the hotel’s digital champion, driving innovation and best practices

Qualifications

What You Will Bring

  • 5+ years in luxury hospitality marketing, e‑commerce, or digital commerce
  • Proven track record driving direct revenue, digital campaigns, and brand.com performance
  • Experience with booking engines, OTAs, digital distribution, loyalty programs, and CRM campaigns
  • Analytical expertise in KPIs, revenue performance, and campaign ROI
  • Luxury brand sensibility with strategic commercial acumen
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; French is a plus
  • Multi‑property or pre‑opening experience is advantageous

Additional Information

How You Will Shine

  • Express entrepreneurial spirit and leadership while embodying the French Art de Vivre
  • Demonstrate humble excellence through a distinguished presence, refined savoir‑faire, and meticulous attention to detail (Cousu Main)
  • Be a passionate team player — warm, sociable, and genuinely caring toward others
  • Exhibit a strong sense of luxury by creating meaningful stories, rituals, and traditions
  • Embrace a true Francophile mindset, showing curiosity and appreciation for French language, culture, history, and cuisine
  • Demonstrate open‑mindedness, creativity, and a spirit of innovation
  • Act as a cultural link by engaging with local arts, gastronomy, fashion, and contemporary design
  • Champion committed luxury with a strong sense of care and responsibility

description:
A L'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Por mais de um século, a L'Oréal dedicou-se exclusivamente a “criar a beleza que move o mundo"; é agora a líder mundial da indústria, com vendas consolidadas de €29 bilhões. Juntos, resolvemos desafios complexos em grande escala, enquanto continuamos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta. Experimente a emoção da agilidade para moldar o futuro da beleza; onde diversidade e propósito se unem e criam um impacto significativo.

No Brasil, o Dermaclub é o nosso programa de fidelidade e clube de vantagens para as marcas de Dermocosméticos (La Roche-Posay, Vichy, CeraVe & SkinCeuticals), um ecossistema robusto que conecta milhões de consumidores a nossas marcas e a uma vasta rede de farmácias parceiras. Com uma base de dados de 8 milhões de pessoas, o Dermaclub é um pilar fundamental para a construção de marca, impulsionamento de vendas e aprofundamento do relacionamento com nossos consumidores.

Missão

Como Gerente de Dermaclub no Brasil, você será o proprietário da marca Dermaclub, do programa de fidelidade e da estratégia de CRM, com a missão de desenvolver e implementar iniciativas que elevem a experiência do consumidor, impulsionem o engajamento e garantam a rentabilidade do programa. Sua visão estratégica e paixão por dados, tecnologia e inovação serão cruciais para continuar a expansão e o sucesso deste ativo tão valioso para a L'Oréal Brasil.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão Financeira e de Rentabilidade (P&L): Gerenciar o orçamento do Dermaclub, monitorar indicadores financeiros e garantir a rentabilidade do programa, identificando oportunidades de otimização e crescimento.
  • Desenvolvimento e Implementação Estratégica: Definir e implementar a estratégia geral do Dermaclub, estabelecendo metas claras, KPIs de desempenho e o planejamento orçamentário para todas as iniciativas do programa.
  • Criação de Roadmap Estratégico: Desenvolver um roadmap estratégico de longo prazo para a marca Dermaclub, antecipando tendências de mercado, necessidades dos consumidores e inovações tecnológicas para assegurar a relevância e competitividade do programa.
  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Time: Liderar, inspirar e desenvolver um time multidisciplinar, incluindo profissionais de marketing, tecnologia e dados, promovendo um ambiente de alta performance e colaboração.
  • Liderança Técnica e Operacional de CRM, Dados & Loyalty: Ser o ponto focal técnico e estratégico para todas as ações de CRM, gestão de dados e fidelidade das marcas da divisão, garantindo a excelência na execução e o uso inteligente dos insights para personalização.
  • Gestão e Implementação de Novas Parcerias: Identificar, negociar e implementar novas parcerias estratégicas que agreguem valor ao programa Dermaclub e ampliem os benefícios para os membros.
  • Interface e Negociação com Times Comerciais e de Trade de Beleza Dermatológica: Colaborar de forma próxima com os times Comercial e de Trade para alinhar estratégias, garantir a integração do Dermaclub nos canais de venda e otimizar a performance em farmácias parceiras.
  • JBPs (Joint Business Plans) e Cycle Plan: Participar ativamente da construção e execução dos Joint Business Plans com parceiros estratégicos e do Cycle Plan das marcas LBD, assegurando a sinergia entre o programa de fidelidade e as iniciativas comerciais.
  • Interface LATAM e Internacional da divisão: Representar o Brasil e colaborar com os times regionais (LATAM) e globais da divisão, compartilhando melhores práticas, recebendo orientações e adaptando estratégias globais à realidade local.

title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description:
Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, Peru

Over the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity; and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.

Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self‑motivated, creative team member integral to the long‑term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.

Responsibilities

International Ocean Policy

  • Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.
  • Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.
  • Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.
  • Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.
  • Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.g., side events, meetings with countries and partners).
  • Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like‑minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs.

Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries

  • In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities.
  • Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean‑climate policy.
  • As needed, facilitate in‑person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives.
  • Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs.

Blue Climate Program

  • Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed.
  • Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects.

Other duties as assigned by supervisor.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required.
  • Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions.
  • This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.
  • Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones.
  • Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high‑level policy events.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora.
  • Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment.
  • Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills.
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to adapt in a fast‑paced, changing environment.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse, international team.
  • Experience partnering with, and influencing, key stakeholders and building strong partnerships across public and private sectors and civil society.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, and ability to effectively communicate complex information to a diverse audience.
  • Enthusiasm and capacity for learning scientific and related basis for specific conservation outcomes as needed to support policy priorities and processes.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

Preferred

  • Bi‑lingual or multilingual in official UN languages.
  • Expertise in coastal blue carbon and marine ecosystems, climate change science, and/or nature‑based solutions.
  • Master’s degree or other advanced degree in environmental policy or related field.
  • Experience working globally in a range of cultural settings.

To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter.

description:

Our Vision

What will you be doing?

title: Director, School Counseling and University Admissions
description:
Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations’ lives? Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part‑time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You’ll play a key role in delivering high‑quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Director of School Counseling and University Admissions to serve as a critical bridge between our A‑level and US curriculum pathways. This role combines strategic leadership with hands‑on student counseling to ensure every CGA student receives world‑class university guidance while building scalable systems that maintain excellence as we grow. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in both US and UK education systems, demonstrated success in placing students in top universities globally, and the vision to create comprehensive programs that develop future‑ready students. This role requires someone who can work directly with students requiring personalized counseling while simultaneously building the infrastructure, playbooks, and training materials that enable consistent counseling quality across our global team.

Purpose

Support students across both curriculum pathways (A‑level and US) to help ensure a unified approach to setting students up for success and consistency of practice for academic excellence. This role acts as a bridge between the two curriculum pathways, ensuring that students have the support they need to choose the path that best aligns with their future goals. You’ll provide hands‑on student counseling support for top universities, support clubs, create enrichment programs, and build scalable systems to ensure students arrive at the application stage well‑prepared with strong academic foundations, examination results, rich extracurricular profiles, global competencies in real‑world experiences, and clear university pathways aligned to personal goals and CGA’s institutional strengths.

Key Responsibilities

Cross‑Pathway Leadership & Coordination

  • Facilitate knowledge sharing and best practice exchange between campuses and across curriculum types (A‑level and US pathways)
  • Collaborate with academic staff, admissions teams, and deans to align curricular offerings with student outcomes and market demand
  • Monitor and benchmark academic performance across campuses and curricula to drive continuous improvement
  • Ensure consistency of practice for academic excellence across both curriculum pathways
  • Work as part of an extended team across time zones to support our global nature

Examination Management & Academic Performance

  • Support examination management across A‑levels, AP, and SAT programs
  • Develop and oversee comprehensive exam preparation programs across all curricula
  • Implement data‑driven strategies to improve student outcomes
  • Support accreditation and compliance for institutional relationships

Academic Enrichment & Future‑Ready Student Development

  • Create programs that develop globally competitive students prepared for the future of work
  • Support and coordinate academic competitions to build student competitiveness
  • Develop real‑world experiences and vibrant community connections for students
  • Support student clubs and enrichment programs
  • Ensure students develop strong academic foundations, rich extracurricular profiles, and global competencies
  • Build connections between students and opportunities that develop future‑ready skills

Clubs & Extracurricular Programs

  • Design and implement a comprehensive club structure and system across CGA that ensures consistency and quality
  • Support student clubs and organizations to foster community connection in a virtual environment
  • Create frameworks and guidelines for club formation, leadership, and sustainability
  • Develop and maintain a diverse portfolio of extracurricular opportunities aligned with university admissions expectations
  • Ensure student leadership development through club participation and officer roles
  • Monitor club engagement and participation to identify opportunities for student connection
  • Build partnerships with external organizations to provide authentic extracurricular experiences
  • Track and document student extracurricular involvement for university applications
  • Create virtual and asynchronous club opportunities that accommodate students across time zones

Direct University Admissions Counseling

  • Deliver world‑class university admissions counseling through direct student support
  • Work directly with a select cohort of high‑intensity students requiring comprehensive personalized counseling
  • Provide strategic planning for university applications, including subject selection and pathway decisions
  • Manage predicted grades and letters of recommendation for students
  • Guide students through UCAS, Common App, and country‑specific application systems
  • Ensure students meet all deadlines across multiple application systems globally
  • Review and provide feedback on personal statements, essays, and supplemental materials
  • Provide comprehensive guidance on university selection across US, UK, Canadian, European, Australian, Asian, and other international systems
  • Coordinate financial aid and scholarship applications with families
  • Maintain current knowledge of admissions requirements, deadlines, and trends across global universities

Building Scalable Systems & Infrastructure

  • Build scalable systems that ensure all CGA students receive expert guidance through their application process
  • Create comprehensive counseling playbooks and frameworks for counselors and deans to follow
  • Develop standardized processes for predicted grades, recommendation letters, and application quality assurance
  • Build training materials and resources to establish consistent counseling quality across the team
  • Establish quality standards and benchmarks for university counseling
  • Design asynchronous resources supporting part‑time students through their application journeys
  • Develop and maintain an extensive database of university programs, scholarships, and requirements globally
  • Build systems that can evolve as our school grows

Data & Performance Tracking

  • Support data dashboards tracking application progress and outcomes for areas of improvement
  • Ensure data is transparent and reportable across all school leadership
  • Track and analyze university admissions outcomes to inform program improvements
  • Generate reports on student outcomes and program metrics
  • Use data to identify trends and optimize counseling strategies

Strategic Partnerships & Market Intelligence

  • Monitor global education and admissions trends to adjust CGA's approach and maintain competitive advantage
  • Cultivate relationships with university admissions offices to enhance CGA's institutional reputation
  • Build partnerships with universities to create opportunities for CGA students
  • Represent CGA at virtual university fairs and recruitment events
  • Stay informed about test‑optional policies, holistic admissions trends, and evolving university requirements

Student Support & Academic Advising

  • Advise students on course rigor, AP subject selection, A‑level subject combinations, prerequisites, and graduation requirements
  • Provide counseling to address academic stress, time management, and study skills
  • Support students navigating the unique challenges of online learning
  • Serve as an advocate for student needs within the school community
  • Coordinate with families through virtual information sessions and regular communication
  • Create learning environments where every student discovers and develops their unique strengths

Administrative & Compliance

  • Maintain accurate student records and university application tracking systems
  • Prepare school reports, transcripts, and counselor recommendation letters
  • Collaborate with school leadership on policy development and strategic planning

Leadership Values & Approach

  • Unlock Potential Together: We work collaboratively. No team is an island. Adapt quickly and find solutions that are in the best interests of our families and CGA as a whole. Every student is a VIP. Make decisive actions to propel us forward through a lens of optimism.
  • Rethink, Rebuild: Avoid defaulting to, “We’ve always done this.” Be curious, look outside your sphere of inspiration, and dive into the data for actionable insights. Online is our advantage. Let’s make the most of the innovation at our fingertips. Take immediate action to improve always, take accountability, follow through, and get ready to optimize again.
  • Raise the bar, compound impact: Continually strive to be better tomorrow. Have high standards for yourself and those around you. Tackle hard things with grit, take your work seriously, but not yourself. Take the time to document work, proactively share learnings, and multiply others’ efforts. Give credit to those making a positive impact.

Qualifications

Education & Credentials

  • Master’s degree in School Counseling, Guidance Counseling, Higher Education, or related field
  • Valid school counseling credential/license (or equivalent from home country)
  • Demonstrable expertise in both US and UK education systems

Experience

  • Minimum 5-7 years of experience in high school college counseling or university admissions
  • Proven track record of successfully placing students in competitive universities globally
  • Experience building scalable systems, frameworks, or programs in an educational setting
  • Experience working with international students or in an international school setting
  • Demonstrated knowledge of university admissions processes in multiple countries (US, UK, Canada, Europe, Asia, Australia)
  • Deep experience with both AP and A‑level curriculum pathways
  • Familiarity with online/virtual education delivery
  • Experience with data analysis and using metrics to drive program improvement

Knowledge & Skills

  • Expert knowledge of US university admissions (Common App, Coalition App, UC system, liberal arts colleges, Ivy League)
  • Expert knowledge of UK university admissions (UCAS, Russell Group, requirements for Oxbridge)
  • Working knowledge of university systems in Canada, Australia, Europe, and Asia
  • Understanding of international baccalaureate equivalencies and credit transfers
  • Proficiency with student information systems and college planning software (Naviance, Scoir, Cialfo, or similar)
  • Strong knowledge of scholarship and financial aid resources globally
  • Familiarity with FERPA, GDPR, and educational privacy laws
  • Ability to develop training materials, playbooks, and scalable processes

Technical & Communication Skills

  • Excellent virtual communication and presentation skills
  • Proficiency with video conferencing platforms (Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams)
  • Strong written communication skills for emails, reports, recommendation letters, and counseling materials
  • Ability to use learning management systems and collaboration tools
  • Digital literacy and comfort with educational technology
  • Experience with data visualization and dashboard creation for tracking outcomes

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
When defining the purpose of a job it is helpful to consider questions like:

  • In what way does it contribute to the value of company?
  • What part of the organisation’s or team’s total purpose is accomplished by people in this job?
  • What is the unique contribution of this job that distinguishes it from other jobs?

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be a valuable team member on our Enterprise Network Operations team supporting SES’s Corporate and Commercial Aviation Networks and Security infrastructure. This individual will be part of a team responsible for the implementation and troubleshooting of SES’s growing network and datacenter presence around the world. You will lead and assist with various projects that will challenge your skills with routing, switching, security, VoIP, and multi-media services including inflight entertainment. This position will work with and manage vendor relations and could have a voice in the purchase/quote process, as our business continues to expand. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, possesses deep troubleshooting skills, and understands the delicate balance between network uptime and security compliance.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve network issues involving Intelsat switches, routers, circuits, etc.
  • Troubleshoot issues with our Palo Alto and Juniper firewall platform as well as implement policy rule changes to facilitate new services and connectivity.
  • Document changes to all SES infrastructure to include Visio diagrams, spreadsheets, and cloud-based tracking and documentation software.
  • Collaborate with Network Engineering on the implementation, buildout, decommissioning, and refresh of SES teleports, datacenters, and sales offices.
  • Coordinate with system design and network operations for existing data expansion, consolidation, and relocation.
  • Manage vendor relationships to get their equipment specs, list prices and other vendor information.
  • Collaborate with Network Engineering on the development of floor plan layouts for datacenters and corporate offices.
  • Develop equipment purchase orders, track orders, and arrange implementation with remote hands if not traveling for datacenter and corporate office related equipment.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5-7 years’ hands‑on experience working in large complex network / datacenter environments specifically managing Cisco, Palo Alto, Juniper and F5 hardware.
  • Strong command of Cisco IOS, IOS‑XE, and NX‑OS, PAN‑OS, JUNOS, F5 and Linux command‑line interfaces.
  • Advanced knowledge of Switching technologies to include, Spanning Tree (RPVST+, MST), LACP, VLANs, and Trunking.
  • Proficient with routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, RIPv2, MPLS, HSRP, VRRP, GLBP, SD‑WAN)
  • Working knowledge of F5 load balancing to include monitoring and troubleshooting load balancing VIPs, pools, and health monitors to minimize downtime and ensure seamless failover across multi‑data center environments
  • Working knowledge of Linux Operating system to include monitoring, automation of operational tasks, and troubleshooting Linux parameters, file systems, and network stacks to maximize performance for high‑throughput applications.
  • Working knowledge with dual homing service providers and ISP redundancy
  • Extensive experience working with Cisco hardware including switches, routers, ASRs, ASA, FWSM, IPS, load balancers, Nexus
  • Hands‑on troubleshooting skills to include Wireshark packet capture debugging and analysis.
  • In depth knowledge of security protocols, TACACS, RADIUS, different flavors of VPN and remote access.
  • Experience with Telco services, T1, DS3, SONET, OC3 – 192.
  • Datacenter design, redundancy and failover experience a plus
  • Racking various types of networks and server equipment.
  • Documentation skills for datacenter, corporate office, and remote sales offices.
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills of datacenter and office network environments.

OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS / COMMENTS

  • PCNSA (Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Administrator)

We are looking for a Senior Integration Engineer to maintain our high-traffic integration backbone. You will be responsible for a diverse environment that spans from TIBCO’s enterprise-grade messaging to Node.js microservices running on OpenShift.

Join our Team

Your responsibility is to ensure that data flows seamlessly across the organization, whether it’s through a traditional MFT process, a Kafka stream, or a GraphQL endpoint.

What you will do

  • Hybrid Integration Management: Develop and support complex integration patterns using both TIBCO BWCE/BW6 and Node.js microservices.
  • API Ecosystem Ownership: Manage our API surface area using TIBCO Mashery, ensuring secure, throttled, and well-documented access for internal and external consumers.
  • Cloud-Native Operations: Deploy, scale, and monitor services within Kubernetes and OpenShift environments, utilizing Docker for consistent delivery.
  • Data Stream Orchestration: Build and maintain high-throughput, event-driven architectures using Kafka for real-time system synchronization.
  • Secure File Transfer: Manage enterprise-level secure data exchanges using TIBCO MFT, ensuring compliance and reliability.
  • Full-Stack Observability: Use the ELK Stack to create dashboards, alerts, and tracing for proactive system health management.
  • Automated Delivery: Maintain and enhance CI/CD pipelines to ensure code moves from CLI to production with zero manual intervention.
  • Coordination with IT/network teams to resolve any operational or functional issues.
  • Deploy CRs on production environments and ensure smooth system performance.
  • Follow ITIL processes and exhibit expertise in incident, problem and change management.
  • Ensure SLA compliance for application and trouble tickets.
  • Coordinating with project teams, vendors, and business teams during the incidents.

What you will bring

  • Education: BSc in Telecommunications, Computer Science or equivalent.
  • 8-12 years of relevant experience in TIBCO container edition products.
  • The TIBCO Suite: Deep expertise in BWCE, BW6, Mashery, and MFT.
  • Container Orchestration: Advanced hands‑on experience with Kubernetes and OpenShift.
  • Development: Proficiency in Node.js for building lightweight, scalable microservices.
  • Messaging & APIs: Expertise in Kafka (pub/sub) and GraphQL (schema design and implementation).
  • Systems Skills: Expert-level CLI skills (Linux/Unix shell) and a strong grasp of Docker networking/volumes.
  • Monitoring: Experience configuring ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) for distributed tracing.
  • Analytical and communication skills to understand the requirements of the customer.
  • Good understanding of the concepts of SOA, ESB and API‑driven integrations.
  • Knowledge of SSL certificates and configuration in TIBCO environment.
  • Strong debugging skills and problem‑solving approach.

Why join Ericsson?

At Ericsson, you’ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what’s possible. To build solutions never seen before for some of the world’s toughest problems. You’ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You’ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

About The Job

The Fintech team is the engine behind Hopper's most innovative and high-margin products, such as Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance . We are responsible for designing, building, and scaling the backend systems that power these proprietary fintech offerings, integrating them with some of the world's largest travel companies (airlines, banks, hotels) through our B2B platform, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions) .

This role is at the center of Hopper's B2B strategy, building highly available, globally-scaled systems that provide peace of mind to millions of travelers on our partners' platforms and drive significant revenue for the company.

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join us in building the future of travel fintech for our HTS APAC and Enterprise airline partners.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

  • Iterate on features in an agile manner using Scala and React (no prior experience required) and technologies like GCP, OpenAPI, BigQuery, Pub/Sub among others.
  • Decide how to best build core systems in the context of our microservices architecture
  • Ship your first code in days, iterating on features in an agile manner
  • Collaborate with a diverse group of people, giving and receiving feedback for growth
  • Execute on big opportunities, helping Hopper rise to the top of the travel industry

An ideal candidate has

  • The ability to bring leading industry techniques and technologies to the table
  • A strong understanding of distributed systems and how architectural decisions affect performance and maintainability
  • Excelled in cross-functional teams, working fluidly with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Frontend Engineers, and other highly skilled specialists
  • A passionate focus on quality, writing testable code that performs and scales
  • The ability to work with minimal guidance, be proactive and to handle uncertainty, ambiguity and the challenge of quickly evolving goals
  • Prior cloud experience
  • Working with Scala and/or React and its libraries
  • Prior airline/travel industry or eCommerce experience
  • Experience in UX design, using tools like Figma

Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR-offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers
  • Very generous parental leave
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work-from-home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More About Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

  • Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.
  • Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.
  • Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.
  • Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.
  • Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels.
  • As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders.
  • Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.
  • Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.
  • Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Especialista de Negócios
description:
Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina. Guiados por um propósito compartilhado de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram, contamos com um portfólio diversificado de marcas e soluções, em diferentes países da América Latina, que contemplam todas as fases da jornada do morar e ainda um Hub de Tecnologia em Portugal. Desenvolvemos tecnologias e inovação para transformar e impulsionar a experiência de moradia como um todo.

Com o apoio de uma equipe de classe mundial de investidores e consultores, como Kaszek, Qualcomm, General Atlantic e SoftBank, o Grupo QuintoAndar está atualmente avaliado em mais de US$ 5,1 bilhões e continua a crescer ano após ano. Aqui você trabalhará com os melhores profissionais do mercado, em um ambiente que respira inovação, colaboração e alto desempenho. Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse

Localização & Trabalho Remoto

Nosso time trabalha no modelo "remote-first", o que significa que estamos trabalhando de casa com a possibilidade de morar em qualquer lugar do Brasil. Também temos a opção de utilizar os escritórios em São Paulo ou utilizar os espaços de coworking de parceiros, ambos até duas vezes por semana.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Aplicação e Triagem
  • Entrevista com People
  • Entrevista com Hiring Manager
  • Case
  • Entrevista com Stakeholder
  • Offer!

O time de Agents Growth atua na aquisição e engajamento dos nossos parceiros e corretores. Acabamos de passar por uma reestruturação e buscamos um(a) Especialista de Negócios para atuar diretamente com a liderança da área, sendo a verdadeira "fonte da verdade" dos nossos indicadores de performance. O seu maior desafio será encontrar o equilíbrio perfeito entre uma altíssima capacidade técnica de manipular dados e um aguçado Business Sense, traduzindo números complexos em ações claras para o negócio.

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Atuar de forma estratégica e generalista apoiando o funil de aquisição de parceiros, garantindo a consistência dos controles e indicadores.
  • Colocar a mão na massa (hands‑on) para estruturar dados hoje desorganizados ou de fontes não oficiais.
  • Construir e conectar lógicas complexas, extraindo dados de diversas fontes (Databricks, planilhas, etc.) para gerar relatórios e dashboards (Metabase, Google Sheets).
  • Evoluir processos analíticos acompanhando as mudanças no sistema e no roadmap de produto.
  • Interagir com líderes e pares em discussões estratégicas de alto nível.

Requisitos:

  • SQL Avançado (Obrigatório): Você precisa ter autonomia total para criar queries, conectar tabelas de diferentes fontes e realizar modelagens complexas.
  • Business Sense afiado: Capacidade comprovada de não apenas extrair dados, mas transformá-los em estratégia.
  • Experiência robusta com manipulação de grandes volumes de dados não estruturados.
  • Resiliência, jogo de cintura e alta capacidade de adaptação para lidar com processos em construção.

Importante

  • O nosso processo seletivo começa na candidatura! Se você está realmente a fim de fazer parte do nosso time, foque nessa etapa do processo. Nós analisamos todos os candidatos individualmente e damos retorno para todas as pessoas que investiram tempo em se candidatar.
  • Toda comunicação é feita por e-mail, então fique atento às nossas mensagens e libere o domínio @quintoandar.com.br para que os e-mails não sejam filtrados como spam.

Benefícios

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Plano de saúde

  • Auxílio creche e Auxílio parentalidade atípica
  • Wellhub
  • Auxílio home office
  • QuintoCare: Nosso programa de apoio (saúde mental, assistência social, apoio jurídico e financeiro)
  • Licença parental estendida

  • Clube de Benefícios (descontos em serviços do dia a dia)
  • Descontos em instituições de ensino
  • Kit leiturinha para crianças - Playkids

Diversidade & Inclusão no Grupo QuintoAndar

Valorizamos a diversidade e queremos que todas as pessoas se sintam bem‑vindas por aqui — independentemente da sua idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, cor, etnia, origem, deficiência, religião ou qualquer outra característica. Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para todas as pessoas! Você verificará que existem algumas perguntas sobre diversidade no formulário de inscrição. Em vagas afirmativas, as informações poderão ser utilizadas para verificar o seu alinhamento com o público‑alvo da oportunidade, podendo, nesses casos, ter caráter eliminatório. Para vagas não afirmativas, esses dados serão utilizados de forma anonimizada, exclusivamente para acompanhar e aprimorar nossas práticas de inclusão nos processos seletivos e sem impacto na sua candidatura.

Privacidade e Proteção a Dados

O Grupo QuintoAndar atua em conformidade com as leis de privacidade e proteção de dados, incluindo, mas não se limitando à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais - LGPD (Lei nº 13.709/2018), e garante a segurança de seus dados pessoais. Para saber mais, acesse o nosso Aviso de Privacidade para Pessoas Candidatas. Se tiver dúvidas ou quiser exercer seus direitos como titular de dados, entre em contato com a gente pelo Canal de Atendimento.

Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público-privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.

Buscamos uma profissional capaz de demonstrar empatia e sensibilidade para lidar com pacientes e familiares em situações delicadas, além de possuir excelentes habilidades de comunicação para transmitir informações de forma clara e eficaz.   • Gestão de Filas: Monitorar e gerenciar o fluxo de pacientes na recepção, garantindo tempos de espera razoáveis e eficiência no atendimento.
  • Manuseio de Chamadas Telefônicas: Atender chamadas telefônicas, direcioná-las para os departamentos apropriados e fornecer informações básicas aos chamadores, conforme necessário.
  • Suporte Administrativo: Auxiliar em tarefas administrativas, como preenchimento de formulários e manutenção de registros.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Prestar um serviço excepcional ao cliente, lidando com consultas, reclamações e preocupações dos pacientes e visitantes de forma cortês e eficaz.
  • Colaboração Interdepartamental: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outros departamentos do hospital, como enfermagem, administração e financeiro, para garantir uma comunicação eficaz e uma experiência integrada para os pacientes.

  • Organização e Gerenciamento do Tempo
  • Resolução de Problemas
  • Discrição e Confidencialidade
  • Capacidade de manter a calma e o profissionalismo em situações de alta pressão e lidar com pacientes e visitantes exigentes ou irritados.

Benefícios

description:
Progressão

Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido

Modelo de trabalho híbrido

Analista de Suporte (Jr Forte / Pleno Leve) | M365 + Service Desk + ERPs + RMM/EDR | Híbrido RJ | Campo pontual

  • Atuação em formato híbrido: 3 dias presenciais no escritório e 2 dias em home office .
  • Os dias de home office são variáveis , definidos pela empresa conforme demandas de atendimento externo, com alinhamento prévio com o colaborador.
  • A função envolve atendimentos externos em clientes , com frequência média de 1 a 2 vezes por semana .

Sobre a GuidelineIT

Na GuidelineIT, a gente faz suporte de um jeito raro: com padrão, processo e cabeça de melhoria contínua. Somos uma empresa de serviços gerenciados (MSP) que atende clientes exigentes e ambientes variados, usando ferramentas e disciplina (ITSM, KB, monitoramento e segurança de endpoint) para resolver de verdade e reduzir reincidência, não só “apagar incêndio”. Aqui você vai trabalhar perto de gente boa, aprender rápido com casos reais, e crescer por entrega e evolução técnica, não por politicagem.

Missão

Assumir a rotina de suporte com padrão GuidelineIT: resolver bem, registrar melhor ainda e reduzir reincidência , atendendo usuários exigentes e clientes VIP com processo, clareza e disciplina de SLA.

O que você vai fazer

80% do tempo (operação e suporte técnico)

  • Atender e conduzir chamados ponta a ponta (incidente/requisição) via ferramenta de Service Desk, com registro completo , evidências (prints/logs) e follow-up.
  • Suporte a Windows 10/11 , aplicativos, impressão e periféricos (diagnóstico e correção).
  • Suporte a Microsoft 365 : criação/ajuste de usuários e licenças, Teams, OneDrive/SharePoint (acesso, sincronização, permissões e troubleshooting comum).
  • Rotinas básicas de Windows Server / Active Directory : usuários, grupos, permissões e noções de GPO/NTFS quando aplicável.
  • Suporte técnico a aplicações de negócio (ERPs) como Nasajon, Systak e Alterdata : instalação/atualização do client, configuração básica, validação de acesso e conectividade, troubleshooting de erros comuns e abertura de chamados com evidências junto ao fornecedor quando necessário.
  • Importante: não é suporte funcional (rotinas contábeis/fiscais/folha). O foco é garantir que o sistema rode e o incidente seja conduzido com padrão.
  • Apoiar rotinas de monitoramento e gestão de endpoints via RMM e EDR (ex.: Bitdefender GravityZone ou similar ): triagem de alertas, checagem de status/atualizações, aplicação de ações básicas e escalonamento com evidências quando necessário.
  • Atualizar e criar artigos na Base de Conhecimento (KB) usando template padrão: passos reproduzíveis e específicos por cliente.

20% do tempo (campo e rotina operacional)

  • Atendimentos externos pontuais: onboarding, validação local, troca de equipamento, ajustes simples e apoio em implantação.
  • Manutenção básica de notebooks (diagnóstico e trocas simples) e organização de ativos/equipamentos.
  • Apoio em projetos de implementação e onboarding de clientes (checklists e padronização).

Requisitos (precisa ter)

  • Experiência real com Service Desk/ITSM e disciplina de SLA/follow-up.
  • Boa base em Windows 10/11 e troubleshooting.
  • Noções práticas de Microsoft 365 (Teams/OneDrive/SharePoint no dia a dia).
  • Base de rede (DNS/DHCP/TCP-IP) para diagnóstico e triagem.
  • Comunicação clara com usuário (conduz solução com educação e objetividade).

Diferenciais

  • Ferramentas ITSM (GLPI/Jira/Freshservice/Zendesk/ServiceNow ou similar)
  • Experiência com RMM (monitoramento, inventário, rotinas e automações simples)
  • Experiência com EDR (Bitdefender ou similar): políticas e tratamento de alertas
  • Noções de firewall/pfSense, backup e Linux básico (terminal, arquivos)
  • Certificações Microsoft ou ITIL (se tiver algo acima disso, melhor ainda)
  • Experiência anterior com suporte técnico a ERPs (instalação, logs, evidências, interface com fornecedor)

O que NÃO é

  • Não é vaga de SOC/Analista de Segurança . O foco é operação, triagem, execução básica e escalonamento com padrão.
  • Não é vaga de Azure/Cloud Engineer “faz tudo”.

Benefícios

  • Subsídio para cursos e estudos
  • Bonificação por certificações Microsoft e similares
  • Comissão por indicação de clientes
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico
  • Day off mensal

Como avaliamos (sem enrolação)

  • Teste prático (cenário real): troubleshooting + escrita de ticket completo (diagnóstico, evidência e fechamento)
  • Entrevista técnica
  • Etapa comportamental com relatos reais (respostas genéricas geradas por IA são desclassificadas)

  • Organizar mapas, relatórios e fechar caixa com precisão;

O que esperamos de você

  • Curso técnico completo em Eletrotécnica, Eletrônica ou equivalente;

  • Leitura técnica e interpretação de esquemas simples;
  • Conhecimento das normas de segurança elétrica (NR10);
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes técnicos;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de OS, emissão de notas e relatórios;
  • Perfil analítico, responsável, comunicativo.

Aqui você vai se destacar se

  • Tem disciplina técnica e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Gosta de resolver problemas de forma prática;
  • Entende que qualidade é parte do resultado.
